scenario: AITA for replacing my SO's yogurts with lo-carb versions? | Throwaway here as my SO reads reddit.. So we've been dating for 18 months and we're really in love with each other. Everything's been nearly perfect, but over the last 8 months my SO has got REALLY into eating a lot of yogurt, which ya know - I'm fine with, its their life, but the side-effects have been really getting to me Reddit... However, a few of my friend's who I mentioned my ruse to have said that ITA for this. Conflicted here!
